title: No version numbers exposed in interface contracts
context: Interface types were tempted to expose version fields for tool status display.
decision: ToolPresentation has no version field. toolPresentation() is the only way to turn a ResolvedTool into something renderable. Components that need version must explicitly retrieve it.
consequences: Decouples interface from backend version complexity. Components cannot accidentally depend on version being present. healthOf() is the single mapping point from backend states (ready|mismatch|unversioned|missing) to interface terms (needs update, not tracked, not installed).
